subject: Access handshake & escorted-entry checklist for enterprise workshop
body:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acmesys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soo Jin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Access handshake & escorted-entry checklist for enterprise workshop

Carlos —

Thanks again for hosting Acme's engineering and security teams for the Dec 2nd Redwood workshop. We're doing a short pre-check on visitor access and badging so day-of entry is smooth. Can you confirm the items below and share any internal forms we should pre-fill?

Key attendees (coming from Redwood):
- Ben Carter — Sales (will bring the demo rack)
- Marissa Cole — Customer Programs (travel lead)
- Olga Petrov — Solutions Ops (onsite point)
- Soo Jin Lee — Security & Compliance

Pre-reads/attachments: visitor-list-acme-20261110.csv (names + IDs) and redwood-onsite-non-disclosure.pdf (signed copy we can bring).

Can you confirm:
- Badge pickup: where should our group check in and do you offer pre-printed visitor badges or mobile QR badges?
- Escort policy: is 1:1 required for all visitors or only for secure zones?
- Device rules: are we allowed to bring demo laptops, an external demo rack, and SSDs containing non-production data?
- Parking/arrival: preferred loading dock for hardware and a point of contact for VIP parking passes.

Attachments: redwood-onsite-non-disclosure.pdf; visitor-list-acme-20261110.csv

Best,
Olga Petrov
Solutions Operations | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

---

From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acmesys.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security Ops <security@acmesys.com>, Jamie Ho <jamie.ho@acmesys.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access handshake & escorted-entry checklist for enterprise workshop

Olga —

Appreciate the heads-up and the attendee list. See the attached Acme Visitor Badging Policy (acme-visitor-badging-policy.pdf) — short answers inline below:

- Badge pickup: We offer pre-printed badges for groups supplied >72 hours in advance; otherwise we issue mobile QR badges via SMS at check-in. Pre-printed is preferred for execs.
- Escort policy: 1:1 escort required for access to R&D labs and any floor marked as "Restricted". Public meeting rooms are unescorted.
- Device rules: Laptops are fine if disk encryption is enabled. External racks are allowed but require advance inventory & serial numbers; storage of demo media overnight must be approved by security.
- Parking/arrival: Use Loading Dock B for equipment drop-off between 07:30–08:30. For VIP parking, we'll arrange two reserved spots near the south entrance — will send passes.

Point of contact for day-of: Jamie Ho (mobile +1 650-555-0199). He will meet the truck and escort the demo rack to Meeting Room C2.

I'll loop in Security to confirm any SOC2-adjacent controls if Soo Jin has specific requirements.

Best,
Carlos Mendez
Director, Strategic Ops | Acme Systems
carlos.mendez@acmesys.com | +1 (650) 555-0122

Attachment: acme-visitor-badging-policy.pdf

---

From: Soo Jin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acmesys.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access handshake & escorted-entry checklist for enterprise workshop

Thanks Carlos — useful details. A few follow-ups from Redwood security so we can finalize the day-of checklist and any paperwork: 

1) Inventory & chain-of-custody for demo hardware
- Please confirm the serials for the demo rack and any external SSDs by Nov 24. We'll bring a paper chain-of-custody sheet to sign on-delivery.

2) Data handling
- Demo media must not contain production customer data. If any sample data is required, please confirm it is synthetic or redacted.

3) Badge exchange & lockers
- If pre-printed badges are provided, can they be stacked alphabetically by last name on arrival? If not, mobile QR badges are acceptable but we request a staff table at check-in to speed issuance.
- For devices left overnight, does Acme provide secured equipment lockers or temporary room keycards?

4) Escort ratio and approval flow
- For Restricted zones we propose a single named Redwood escort per Redwood visitor; if Acme requires additional escorts, please confirm the ratio.

Attachment: onsite-device-acceptance-template.docx (we'll use this to log devices on arrival).

Also, can we get the name and email for the on-site security manager who will sign the acceptance? We'll need that to complete our internal approvals.

Thanks — Soo Jin
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (512) 555-0177

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acmesys.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soo Jin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access handshake & escorted-entry checklist for enterprise workshop

Carlos / Olga —

Thanks for the clarifications. Quick logistics notes from my side: 
- Travel ETA: arriving 12/01 evening (flight AC-178, arriving SFO 18:40). I'll be dropping off the demo rack first thing 12/02 morning.
- Demo inventory attached (demo-inventory-serials.xlsx) — includes model numbers and SSD serials.
- Parking: please confirm the reserved VIP passes and whether I should print them or if they'll be on the car's plate.

On the escort note — if Acme requires 1:1 for the demo area we can assign an additional Redwood escort; Marissa is coordinating travel and can bring an extra staffer if needed. Also — can we reserve Meeting Room C2 for 08:30–13:00? That will be our main demo + breakout space.

Looking forward to it. I'll bring chargers, a spare laptop, and a small battery pack.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0188

Attachment: demo-inventory-serials.xlsx

---

On Sun, Nov 14, 2026 at 09:45 AM -0800 Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acmesys.com> wrote:
> Ben / Olga —
> 
> Thanks — VIP passes will be emailed to your address on 11/29 with a QR code tied to the car plate if you provide it, otherwise printable passes are available at the south entrance. Meeting Room C2 is reserved for 08:30–13:00. Jamie Ho will meet the truck at Loading Dock B at 07:45.
> 
> For the security manager: please have Soo Jin coordinate with Elena Park (elena.park@acmesys.com). She will be the signatory for any device custody forms.
> 
> Carlos
>
> Attachment: none

Notes / next steps:
- Redwood to confirm demo serials by 2026-11-24 (Ben) — demo-inventory-serials.xlsx attached.
- Acme to confirm VIP parking pass method by 2026-11-29 (Carlos).
- Redwood security (Soo Jin) to exchange device-acceptance template with Elena Park ahead of arrival.
- Olga to finalize visitor list and print pre-printed badges if Acme confirms >72hr window.

Attachments referenced in thread: redwood-onsite-non-disclosure.pdf; visitor-list-acme-20261110.csv; acme-visitor-badging-policy.pdf; onsite-device-acceptance-template.docx; demo-inventory-serials.xlsx
